venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Quiet Wednesday at CCATL — -10.1% vs target ($1,316 vs $1,464) on day 3 of the new menu. 40 guests / $32.90 GCA. Food $197. Comps $138.10. **3 Parks Wine 'Pourdown' event nearby drew the foot traffic** — curated wine + music + DJ + validated parking event packed their space; some attendees walked over for quick drinks (to-go cups utilized). **Late-night pop ~10:45pm** — industry friends + neighborhood regulars who saw a live band at Forth Club (singer who opened for Beyonce + sax-playing husband — several neighborhood regulars have referenced this band in recent months). Forth Hotel returning guests came in tonight — likely to repeat tomorrow. Opener cut 8:30pm. Super Martini batch completed. **Food menu feedback continues positive** — Trevor (regular) complimented new Super Martini recipe (scaled-back super brine) and Michelada (note: extra cocktail onions for his Super Martini next time). All guests out by 12:30am. **86**: Shake n Bake Wings. No incidents, no no-show charges. MOD: MKZ // JK. Entered by JK. Kitchen: keep ABK'ing the space; focus on presentation and ticket times; excited to see how new food does over the weekend.

Comps $112 (investor + gifts + a few picky guests with DNLs). **Chartreuse week update**: Space Oddity edged Turtle Power tonight — both 15 sold; **First Time Listener was the star at 16**; Year of the Trees also 15. Specials selling far better tonight than yesterday. **Service shape**: small early pop (better than Tuesday) sustained until ~11pm; midnight pickup steady to last call. **Door (Marielle)**: gradual fill from 6pm res; decent 8pm turn; small waitlist for 2-tops cleared by 10pm; two large parties at 9:30pm kept room full; rain at 11pm slowed foot traffic. **Welcomed**: Haleigh's roommate + grad celebrations including Alexis (past EV host) graduating from her classes; many grad friends. **James exceptionally speedy in service**, Jane queen at point. **No-show**: Tom Mora 3 at 6pm — NOT charged. **Menu count**: 19. **Glassware**: 1 DOF, 1 SOF, 1 Tulip. **Maintenance carryover**: bar stools wobbling (from 5/12) + portal/door/AC backlog. Kitchen excited for new menu items. MOD & Chef: Cara + Steeves. Entered by Marielle. **OPERATIONAL FLAG**: typeform Total field missed food sales — second different EV form-data integrity issue in two weeks. Worth a Marielle/Cara check on the form.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Warm with a side of Dodger win
venues.narrative: **LA beat target +20.2% ($5,270 vs $4,385)** on a rollercoaster Wednesday. Marquee $5,270, SR $0, Event $0. Food $897 (~17.0% mix). Comps $105 (DNL, birthday, industry that brought us pastries + cold brew). 144 guests / **$36.60 GCA** — **LA GCA form bug appears RESOLVED tonight** (form-stated $36.60 matches computed $36.60 after 4-day streak of broken values; check whether the typeform was actually fixed or this submitter happened to enter the correct value). **Service shape**: mellow until ~9:30pm, then a huge wave 10–11:30pm — 20-top filled tables 1–3, many 2-tops easy to seat. **4-top from Ireland** — super sweet, last night with us in LA. **Angel and Julian crushed the floor**; **Ryan ran around supporting** — wrote birthday cards, helped organize the SR, brought good vibes. **Kitchen (Zak + Mike under Vic)**: tickets in waves; early-shift time for projects; lots of desserts and french fries; handed out a few snacks for ticket times — everyone left happy. **Maintenance WIN**: Mr. Jorge cleaned the graffiti in the men's restroom. **86**: cookies. No incidents. No-shows charged. **Favorite moment**: a bottle of CeraVe chillin behind someone's head at Table 1 the whole time. MOD & Chef: Gigi & Vic. venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: MG -25.2% vs target ($4,863 vs $6,500) — third consecutive day soft of target, but **better than 5/12 (-32.2%)** and **food share strong at 41.5% ($2,018)**. Segments: MB Morning $736, MB Evening $4,127, Sun Club $0 (closed), Hot Eye $0 (closed), Events $0. Comps $279. 91 guests (5 AM + 86 PM via OpenTable) / $53.44 GCA. **Morning MOD: Sam & Lex** — slow and average morning. **Evening MOD: James & Shannon** — large group of tour guides drove practically all early-afternoon business; then very slow until 8:30–9pm dinner pop filled most of the restaurant; a few familiar faces eating + visiting but mostly unfamiliar guests; **trend of groups coming in late to hang out for drinks continues**. **Kitchen (Shannon)**: performed well on mostly boring night; the late pop was frustrating and the rail got completely filled at one point, but without it we'd have been 'scarily dead'; all food looked and came out great. **Highlight**: tour guide group very excited about the hotel and hospitality — left lots of goodies to try. **Sun Club** closed; **Hot Eye** closed.
